title: Camera movement
guidance: One flowing present-tense paragraph, under about 200 words.
Start with the main action, then movement and gestures, appearance, environment, camera, lighting and colour.
LTX-2.5 audio: describe ambient sound, put dialogue in quotes with the speaker, name any music.
Describe one main camera move. Place it after the subject and action.

entries.label: Dolly in
entries.prompt: The camera dollies in slowly toward the subject, smoothly tightening the frame.

entries.label: Orbit
entries.prompt: The camera orbits smoothly around the subject, revealing it from every side.
entries.notes: Great for product and hero reveals.

entries.label: Crane up
entries.prompt: The camera cranes upward and rises above the scene, revealing the wider environment.

entries.label: Tracking shot
entries.prompt: The camera tracks alongside the subject, keeping pace with a smooth, steady follow.

entries.label: Static tripod
entries.prompt: The camera is locked off on a tripod, perfectly steady, with the action unfolding within a fixed frame.
entries.notes: Best for dialogue; reduces motion artefacts.

entries.label: FPV drone
entries.prompt: A fast first-person-view drone flies through the scene, swooping, diving and weaving past obstacles.
entries.notes: Fast motion; may be harder to hold coherent.

entries.label: Macro close-up
entries.prompt: An extreme macro close-up with a very shallow depth of field, tiny details sharp and the background soft.

entries.label: Handheld follow
entries.prompt: The camera follows the subject handheld from behind, with gentle natural sway.

entries.label: Whip pan
entries.prompt: The camera whip-pans quickly to the side, blurring into the next moment of the scene.

entries.label: Pull back reveal
entries.prompt: The camera pulls back slowly, widening the frame to reveal the full scene around the subject.
